en: An old black‑and‑white (sepia‑tone) street scene showing a narrow European town street lined with two‑ and three‑story houses. People in early 20th‑century clothing, including women in long skirts, children, and men in uniform-like attire, stand and walk along the street. A church or tower with a small spire is visible in the background. At the top in red Gothic-style script it reads "Bischofswerda. Innere Kamenz er Straße.", and there is a red handwritten number in the upper right corner. Shop signs in German are visible on the right-hand buildings.
